title: Ariadne .ari document, version 1
description: The structure of an Ariadne .ari document (docs/ARIADNE.md). Every map is closed: a key the schema does not list is an error, except keys that start with x- (ignored everywhere), a custom widget's or custom scene node's own keys, and top-level blocks a host registers (register_ari_block) or the document declares in customs:.
$comment: Written to the draft-7-compatible subset json-schema-validator implements: no unevaluatedProperties or prefixItems, and no assertion beside a $ref. A map whose values all have a schema says so with patternProperties ^.*$, not additionalProperties: the validator reports a value's error under additionalProperties as one message at the map, with no pointer into the value (additionalProperties is false only, closing a map). A widget's type is the first of the loader's type keys present (kBuiltinWidgetTypes order, loader.cpp): $defs/short_widget is that order as an if/else chain. A new widget type needs its w_<type> entry, a link in short_widget at its place in that order, and an entry in typed_widget.

meta.description: Provenance and the min_libcvc load gate.

min_libcvc.description: The oldest libcvc that may load the document: an older one refuses it.

windows_menu.description: false turns the built-in Windows menu off; a string renames it.

clock.description: Show the tray's clock or not.

notifications.description: Show the tray's bell or not; always shows it with an empty feed too.

assets.description: Meshes loaded once, shared by every scene: id: { source, fit, ... }.

prototypes.description: Node trees a node's use: stands for (§5.18, Prototypes). Not checked as nodes here: a prototype's values may hold {name} tokens its instances fill in.

data.description: Datasets: name: URI, or { uri | generate, path, as, params, load }; uri may be { arg: <name> }.

anyOf.description: The document's argument of this name (its args: block).

customs.description: The custom types the document uses: one of widget:/node:/block: each; required: true refuses to load without it.

requires.description: What the document needs from its host (docs/ARIADNE.md §5.7).

state.description: Literal values written under the document's prefix just before init: runs (docs/ARIADNE.md §5.3).

keys.description: Rebindable key actions: id: { label, key, on }.

units.description: Widget templates include: instantiates. A template is checked as a widget when it is included, after its args are substituted.

import.description: Libraries whose units: and functions: this document uses.

functions.description: (defun name (params) body...) forms every program in the document can call.

channels.description: The message channels the document uses.

args.description: The document's command line: name: type, or { type, default, help, required, positional }.

tests.description: name: program; ari test runs each.

needs.description: A module's: the link: holes it expects its mount to grant.

catalog.description: Tooling data (the component library's INDEX.ari); not a widget tree.

collections.description: Tooling data (the component library's top INDEX.ari): its collections, each a subdirectory with an INDEX.ari of its own.

moved.description: Tooling data (the component library's top INDEX.ari): the forwarders left at the old paths of components that moved into a collection.

python.description: Python for a scripting host (arix, ariglx).

wasm.description: A WebAssembly module for a scripting host: its path alone, or a map with module:.

server.description: For the relay that runs the document (arisrv --doc); a bare server: asks for nothing.

relay.description: For a host that joins a relay: the relay's URL alone, or a map with url:.

world.description: The world's rules (vehicles, spawns, ...), read by the world runtime; a bare world: sets none.

scalar.description: A scalar the loader reads as text.

state_tree.description: A state: block's keys (docs/ARIADNE.md §5.3): each a path segment (dots allowed; a top-level one may start with / for the app root), its value written as spelled, a list of scalars joined by commas, nothing (or an empty block) as "", a map one level deeper. The names are the document's own, so the keys are open.

label.description: A widget's label: its type key's value (empty is no label).

program.description: A state_exec program (an s-expression), or a bare name a host handles.

predicate.description: A state_exec predicate the read lane re-evaluates each frame.

flag.description: A boolean in any spelling the loader reads: true/false, yes/no, on/off, y/n (any case), 1/0.

strings.description: One string or a list of them.

color.description: A colour: [r, g, b] (0..1), "#rrggbb", "#rgb", c0..c7, "r,g,b", none, { bind: <key> }, or an expression "(...)" computed each frame.

option_colors.description: A radio's colour: one for every option, or one an option: a list of colours, or "c0;c1;..." text.

commit.description: live: every change while dragged; release: once, at the end.

collapse.description: auto (fold the menus into one when they do not fit), never or always; a boolean reads as auto or never.

maximized.description: Start maximized: true, false, or phone (only on a phone).

options.description: The options: a list, or an expression giving one, re-evaluated each frame.

pos.description: [x, y] in px from the work area's top-left.

extent.description: A size: px, "N%", a fraction 0 < v < 1 (a share), 0 or auto (fit).

size_box.description: [w, h], or { hint: [w, h], min: [w, h], max: [w, h] }; each an extent.

media_size.description: W (px; the height follows), "N%" of the line's width, or [W, H] (H may be auto).

layout.description: How a window, overlay or group lays out its children.

background.description: A window's, overlay's or group's backdrop: a picture's URI or image name, [r, g, b], or a map.

runs.description: Rich text: a list of runs (a string, or { text, style, href, on_click, tooltip }), or a state path / expression giving one.

repeat.description: A count: a number, a state key or an expression; {i} in the copies' strings is the index.

widget_common.description: The keys every widget takes (its own type's keys are listed on its schema).

id.description: The widget's stable identity (its view state persists under tree.<id>).

type.description: The widget type, when not written as the first key.

tab.description: This child's title in a tabs: widget.

tooltip.description: Hover text, or an expression "(...)" giving it.

context_menu.description: A right-click menu (docs/ARIADNE.md §5.30): its items, as a menu's items:, or { id, items }, whose id names it for contributes: context_menus:.

w_group.description: A group of widgets (also written as a map with only children:).

w_panel.description: A panel: drawn as a group.

w_menubar.description: A menu bar: its menus, tray icons and the Windows menu.

w_menu.description: A menu in a menu bar.

w_menu_item.description: A menu item: an action (on:) or a toggle (bind:).

load_site.description: load: <uri> mounts another .ari as an isolated module under includes.<as> (docs/ARIADNE.md §6.3).

name.description: A state key or an expression, worked out each frame ({i} its instance under repeat:), that names the application instead when not empty.

functions.description: The functions it grants the module: names, or "*".

link.description: Holes into the parent's state: name: target (read-write), or { to, mode: ro|rw } (read-only unless mode is rw).

channels.description: Channels granted to the module, as link: (a map with no mode is read-only).

uri_list.description: URI prefixes: one, a list of them, or { bind: <key> } naming a state key that holds them.

mounts_site.description: mounts: <state key> holds one isolated mount per child of the key: <key>.<as>.uri, .args, .view, .background, .budget (docs/roadmap/ARIADNE_SHELL.md 4.2, docs/ARIADNE.md §6.8).

allow.description: The URI prefixes that may be mounted; absent or empty: any file or link.

catalog.description: The catalog's documents, which run as the local principal; the rest run as file: or remote: ones.

widget.description: A widget: a map whose type is its first known key (slider_int: Speed) or type:, an include:, load: or mounts: entry, or a bare string (a text label, or separator, windows_menu, clock, bell, spinner).

transfer_function.description: A transfer function: the model form (docs/TRANSFER_FUNCTIONS.md §10.1) or the legacy points.

vinay.description: A Vinay colour table file (a URI).

source.description: A node's source: a URI, or a map naming a primitive, a generated or computed field, a dataset or a file.

data.description: A dataset the data: block names.

heightfield.description: A displaced grid (heightfield:), or a cvc::world generator's ground (terrain:, or a generator: here).

pbr.description: Physically based shading (docs/ARIADNE.md §5.4): true for the defaults, or its values.

visible.description: true/false, a state key to follow, or { bind, default }.

shader.description: A shader preset's name, or { preset, disable_coord_shift, vertex/fragment: [{at, code}] } GLSL splices.

clip.description: Clip planes and a clip box in the node's frame.

body.description: The node's rigid body in the scene's physics world: the motion alone, or a map.

node_builtin.description: A built-in scene node: every key is checked.

type.description: geometry (the default), volume, volren, volslice, group, or a custom node type.

world.description: The world this node belongs to (drawn only while it is on).

frame.description: Frame the camera on a source: { data } node's dataset.

fit.description: Stand a mesh on the ground at a height.

on_pick.description: A program run when a press lands on the node or on a descendant without one of its own, and on that press's drags and release; in the document's scope.

use.description: A prototypes: entry this node stands for, its own keys over the prototype's.

label.description: A label drawn over the node (scene_labels).

model.description: A geometry node's model, drawn in place of its own geometry.

tint.description: satellite: a city's buildings take the aerial image's colours.

look.description: A world dataset's look, as on generated_world: soft (matte daylight) or classic.

underside.description: Draw the rock under a world dataset with no shore (default 0).

texture.description: A world dataset's water texture size in texels (default 2048; clamped to 256-4096).

sway.description: How far a world dataset's trees sway in the scene's wind (default 1; 0 holds them).

region.description: [min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y] in world metres: the cut a source: { data } node's world takes before the physics and the navigator see it.

water_level.description: A source: { data } node's still water level (m), in place of its dataset's.

node_custom.description: A node of a custom type (register_scene_node_type): its own keys are its realizer's (SceneNode::props), so only the built-in ones are checked.
